content:
Evidence from the datasheet: CDR engaged → 25.78 Gbps, 25GbE / 25GBASE-SR; CDR bypassed → 9.953 Gbps (10GbE-WAN) and 10.312 Gbps (10GbE-LAN). Typical reach 70 m (OM3) and 100 m (OM4) apply to the same product row. Post-FEC BER 1×10⁻⁵ (overview) and 5×10⁻⁵ (receiver footnote at 25.78 Gbps) both refer to 25G only. 28.0 Gbps is marketing/SFP28 naming only—not a selectable rate in the CDR table—so it is not assigned.
